Are you passionate about building enterprise-scale AI solutions and leading cutting-edge projects in Generative AI and multi-agent systems? Join us to shape the future of AI-powered enterprise platforms.

Architect and lead innovative GenAI and Agentic AI solutions at scale

Lead end-to-end AI product development – from ideation to production deployment

Mentor engineering teams through architecture and design reviews
Collaborate closely with clients to define AI strategy, use cases, and roadmaps
Partner with Data Engineering, Cloud, Cybersecurity, and Business teams to deliver integrated AI solutions

2–8 years in technology with 2+ years in GenAI / LLM engineering
Deep expertise in LLMs, Agentic AI, multi-agent architectures, RAG frameworks, prompt engineering, AI governance, and responsible AI

Strong Python and software engineering skills
Experience building AI Copilots and enterprise AI platforms

Leadership experience in AI engineering teams
Exposure to AI product management and solution architecture
Experience with multimodal AI, document intelligence, and enterprise search
Relevant certifications (Azure AI, AWS AI/ML, Google AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)


Education Qualification:
B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech/MS in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related fields

Job Summary
Design, deploy and operationalise production-grade AI, ML and Generative AI systems, including LLM-powered enterprise applications.
Role Overview
Build end-to-end AI/ML solutions spanning data pipelines, model development, deployment and monitoring.
Develop scalable LLM-powered applications that integrate reliably with business workflows.
Key Responsibilities
Design and deploy machine learning, deep learning, NLP and Generative AI systems.
Build RAG pipelines, semantic search, embeddings and vector-database integrations.
Create REST APIs, model-serving layers, CI/CD pipelines and automated retraining workflows.

Required Skills
4+ years in Python, ML engineering, data science engineering or MLOps roles.
Strong Python, SQL, data structures, REST APIs and feature-engineering fundamentals.

Experience with model monitoring, versioning, PostgreSQL or MongoDB and production system design.
Preferred
Experience with LangChain or LlamaIndex, MLflow or Weights & Biases.
Exposure to FastAPI, Flask, Django, BentoML or TorchServe.
FinTech, SaaS or fast-growing AI company experience is preferred.
